prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing.

a warm caramel complexion, late 30s goddess, curved bust physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — an extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person; both her bust and her hips are simultaneously, dramatically enormous, a colossal heavy bust resting full and wide, and enormous round hips flaring just as dramatically wide below, but unlike a sharply cinched hourglass, her waistline stays soft and only gently defined between them, a full, natural figure rather than a snatched one; gigantic soft thighs pressed together, very thick soft arms, a full round face; her head looks small on top of her massive body; her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other, high ponytail teal hair — wearing a skin-tight ultra-high-cut micro swimsuit of glossy white patent vinyl, made of two small triangle cups held by thin halter strings behind her neck and back, joined to the bottom by two thin vertical straps of the same vinyl about two fingers apart that run down on either side of her navel from the lower corners of the cups to the top corners of the bottom, linked by three small horizontal straps with polished silver buckles stacked down the center of her stomach, her waist sides, her flanks and the skin between and around the straps bare, the bottom is only a small triangle at the front cut extremely high up to the very top of her hip bones, her hips, thighs and legs completely bare, the vinyl shrink-wrapped onto her body like a second skin, fully opaque, her arms bare, her face and hands bare. Real photographic skin on her face, neck, arms, hands, stomach, thighs and legs, with visible pores and fine grain, fine peach-fuzz hairs and a faint natural flush on her cheeks and chest, fine blue-green veins on the backs of her hands and a light scatter of faint freckles across her shoulders and upper arms. The materials show real behaviour: the polished silver buckles catching small bright highlights, the glossy vinyl molded so closely that it shows the dip of her navel, her ribs and her hip bones, a wet-looking sheen sliding over each contour. Pose: strong hip pop left, both hands pressing outer hips outward arching back to extreme — most extreme curved bust silhouette ever displayed.
Footwear: heels of the most absurdly extreme height imaginable, knee-high lace-up platform stiletto boots made of glossy white leather, each with a razor-thin tapered heel taller than her entire shin from ankle to knee and a towering hidden front platform, her feet arched fully vertical on the very tips of her toes like a dancer on pointe, her legs stretched impossibly long and her whole body lifted far above the ground on them as if standing on stilts.
Nails: the longest nails physically imaginable, curved talon nails each as long as her forearm is wide, in glossy white lacquer with a high polish.
Jewelry: sculpted gold armbands high on both upper arms, a wide gold waist chain resting over the carved curve of her hips, and thick polished gold bangles stacked on both wrists. Jewelry is metal and pearl only, worn on the body, nothing added to her face or ears.
Face: her face is bare of any garment — real living flesh with real pores, a soft sheen of natural oils and bright real catchlights, the face of a real Latina woman with high cheekbones, large dark eyes and full lips, an unmistakably feminine face with a calm, composed expression, makeup: pushed to the absolute extreme, thick opaque layers piled on: an opaque thick white eyeshadow smeared from the lash line up to the brows, thick white paint under the lower lashes, a very wide bright turquoise liner flaring far past the outer corners, extremely long clumped false lashes top and bottom, opaque glossy white lips.

Background: green stepped rice terraces with a stone path, a waist-high stone wall and a standard-height farm hut door at her side, under a soft overcast sky with gentle diffused light, lit by natural light with soft shadows, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus. ONE woman only. Full-length wide shot from a moderate distance with the camera at waist height, the whole figure from the soles of the boots to the top of her head completely visible, with the door, railing or steps beside her at normal human scale so the extreme heel height reads at a glance, the towering heels clearly separating the boot soles from the floor. This is one single photograph taken with one camera at one moment, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/5.6, realistic photographic grain, a real photograph. Portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
